summary: This paper presents a definitive, mathematically complete, and formally verified resolution of foundational open problems concerning Renyi entanglement asymmetry and the quantum Mpemba effect recently introduced by Travaglino, Mazzoni, and Calabrese (2026). The author proves four major theorems: (1) exact sharp U(1)-monotonicity domains for Renyi difference ({1}), Petz Renyi divergence ([0, 2]), and sandwiched Renyi divergence ([1/2, infinity]), supported by explicit low-dimensional counterexamples; (2) construction of permanent spurious quantum Mpemba effects in Delta S^(2) under U(1)-covariant channels where all genuine monotones are forbidden from crossing; (3) analytic resolution of the ordered-SWAP alpha_c = 1/2 phase transition via Laguerre-Descartes' Rule of Signs for real Dirichlet polynomials; and (4) complete mixed-state duality laws, universal single-qubit polynomial deficit factorizations, d = 3 breakdown, K-sector pinching ceilings, and exact finite-group Z_K replica identities. All theorems are machine-verified in Lean 4 and audited via zero-float exact rational certificates.
